    How to Play

    GOAL

    Score the most by building interlocking words. Refill to 7 tiles each turn. The match ends when the bag empties and someone clears their rack, or after everyone passes twice running.

    PLACING TILES

    • Drag a tile onto the board — the target square lights up and the tile snaps into it on release.
    • Or tap a tile, then tap a square.
    • New tiles must form one unbroken row or column.
    • The first word must cover the centre ★; later words must touch existing tiles.
    • Drag a glowing placed tile back to the rack to undo it.

    PREMIUM SQUARES

    TW triples the word · DW doubles it (★ is a DW on the opening word) · TL triples the letter · DL doubles it. They only count the turn a tile lands there — and they ignite when your word is cast.

    YOUR ART

    Open the Art Gallery (palette icon) and drop in your own images. Six slots: hero board, neon particles, glass letters, trophy, light rays and the rack. Each has its own opacity, and all are saved locally.

    NEW WORDS

    Rejected word? Hit Look up. If a live dictionary confirms it, add it to your lexicon: the move unlocks instantly and the word stays for every future match.

    BINGO & END

    Use all 7 tiles for +50. At the end everyone subtracts their leftover tiles; a player who went out collects everyone else's.

    CAMERA

    Drag empty board to rotate, scroll to zoom, shift-drag to pan. Touch: one finger rotates, two pinch-zoom and twist.
